notes.note: Link in the settings navigation to the reconciler settings page.
Title of the reconciler settings page and its entry in the browser tab.

segment.source: The reconciler compares what connectors and probes see with the intended addresses and proposes the differences. These settings are the same on every controller and apply at the next run, without a restart.
The settings were changed by someone else in the meantime. The form shows the current values. Check them and save again.

notes.note: The limits under a field; the values come with their unit, for example 30 s to 1 d.

segment.source: The refresh interval must be shorter than the retention ({retention}).

notes.note: Shown for the problem code ipam.reconciler.settings.invalid; the key lives here because the page does not load the discovery message pack.

segment.source: The server refused the value of {field}. Check the limits under the field.
When on, the adoption policies of the prefixes approve matching proposals by themselves. When off, every proposal waits for a person.
How often the reconciler runs on its own. A run also starts after an ingest or a change to the intent.
How long a run waits after an ingest or a change to collect what follows. 0 starts it at once.
How often an unchanged fact is written again with a new last sighting. It must be shorter than the retention.
How often facts past their retention are removed.
How long an address that was seen may go unseen before it is proposed as orphaned.
How long a fact is kept after its last sighting.
